target_customer: Originally startup leaders wanting daily progress reports; now consumers who buy a private home AI device
problem: Leaders lose visibility as teams grow and information scatters; the later pivot targets people who want their personal data and AI to stay on hardware they own.
business_model: Originally SaaS reports; now hardware sales (Oki Home with a removable Memchip, reservations open)
product_category: Personal AI hardware (memory computer), earlier workplace AI reporting

founders.name: Luofei Chen
education: UC Berkeley, M.E.T. dual degree in Engineering and Business (per YC page)

founders.name: Aayush Tyagi
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder on the YC company page and Oki AI launch post; no bio found.

technical_complexity.rationale: The later pivot needs custom hardware, local model inference and storage design; the original product was integration and summarization over Slack, GitHub and Jira.

defensibility.rationale: The original reporting product was easy to copy; hardware adds supply chain cost but no proven moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No action against Oki found; a comparison post named Linear and Jellyfish as adjacent tools.

market_need_then: Engineering leaders wanted cross-tool visibility; coverage dated July 2025 framed the pain as information scattering as startups grow.

branding.domain_note: Product site is okihome.ai, not oki.com (Oki Electric Industry is a large unrelated company).

identity.mascot_or_character: Oki is the name of the AI assistant
identity.visual_style: Premium hardware look, bead-blasted aluminum with satin finish
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, home-centered; tagline 'Your digital life, at home'

branding.community_and_virality: Site says Batch 1 of Oki Home is sold out (company claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Short friendly name with a product family (Oki Home, Desk, OS, Memchip), but searches found no independent press on the brand and the name collides with Oki Electric and others.

pivots.from: Oki AI, daily personalized company progress reports (launched July 2025)
pivots.to: Oki Home, a consumer memory computer with local AI
pivots.why: Not stated; one article says the pair is moving from workplace software toward a consumer device.

outcome_analysis: Oki entered YC in Winter 2025 with a workplace reporting tool, then pivoted to a private home AI computer sold on reservation. No funding beyond aggregator claims, no exit and no shutdown were found. Hardware execution, shipping timelines and pricing changes are the key risks, with delivery now listed for 2027.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked and StartupIntros list 500K in March 2025 with Y Combinator, a Sixtyfour page lists 6M but appears mismatched to another company, and one article says MiraclePlus also backs Oki. None is primary, so no round is recorded. Oki Home price differs by source (1,799 in articles, 2,299 on the current site) and shipping moved from mid-December 2026 to Q1 2027. Founder Aayush Tyagi's last name comes from search snippets of YC-hosted pages; the fetched YC page gave only 'Aayush'. The competitor search found no dated competitors; the list is empty. Outcome search returned only unrelated Oki Electric results.
